revision_summary: Two quote-check failures need fixing: (1) objections[1] cites '05:19' for the HOA/government monologue quote, but those words actually occur at [03:19]-[03:35]; correct the timestamp to ~03:19. (2) script_coverage prior_design section attributes a condensed/altered customer quote ('it's a Glide. It's a solar edge system.') to ts 00:42 (which is actually the rep's question), when the customer's actual words span [00:47]-[00:59] ('it was a Glide. It was put in the Glide, but it's a solar edge system.') — fix both the timestamp and quote fidelity. Beyond the quote fixes, tone down the 'single biggest missed value in the call' superlative on the roofing cross-sell moment (06:04) given the signal is speculative and 10-15 years out with the customer indicating he'd self-initiate contact. Reconsider forcing coaching_philosophy.objection_inversion onto the 02:42 monologue moment, since the customer isn't raising a live purchase-avoidance objection but rather delivering an unsolicited economics lecture post-DQ — this is a stretch application of the schema concept. Optionally note the 00:12 audio friction opening and the vague/hedging referral language at 01:05 as minor additional coaching color. None of these rise to a full rerun — the core trajectory read (DQ'd orphaned call, scope creep on technical questions, missed but speculative roofing signal) is sound and well-supported overall.
